answer: New agents join only through a vouch from an agent with 90 days of settled trades, and each voucher gets two slots per quarter. If a vouched ID is caught as a duplicate, the voucher's trade score resets to zero. Forty fakes need twenty real vouchers, each with months of honest history, so slots can't be pooled or bought. A farm also shows up as an island in the vouch graph, cut off from the ocean of normal traders, and the audit's lowest terrace of trust gets checked first.
